task: Classify immune class in lung adenocarcinoma. Classes: low, medium, and high immune class. On H&E, distinguish the degree of tumor-associated lymphocytic infiltration, stromal immune cell density, tertiary lymphoid aggregates, and inflammatory reaction around tumor nests.

classes.0: Low immune class with sparse tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and little stromal inflammatory response.
classes.1: Medium immune class with a moderate lymphocytic infiltrate and intermediate stromal immune activation.
classes.2: High immune class with dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, prominent stromal inflammation, and possible lymphoid aggregates.
